title: Váratlan helyzetek (Handling the Unexpected)
grammar: Negotiating Clarification & Polite Assertiveness with Attól tartok, hogy...

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can resolve communication misunderstandings politely using ha jól értem.
I can soften a disagreement with attól tartok, hogy... and nem feltétlenül értek egyet.
I can use four words for misunderstanding, clarification, an unexpected situation and resourcefulness.
I can say that I am afraid we misunderstood each other.
